note: Both sets correctly transcribe the Table 7-1 sensitivity values with proper wind-speed/rotor-speed/pitch conditions and supporting quotes, and both are padded with many redundant duplicate claims. Set A covers all 15 table rows, including the 15.0 m/s (-64.44E+6) and 22.0 m/s (-105.90E+6) rows that Set B omits entirely, plus the rated rotor speed. Set B uniquely captures the rated mechanical power (P0 = 5.296610 MW), which A misses, but it drops two table rows and repeats several rows up to three times. Neither set contains misread or invented values, so A's more complete table coverage gives it a slight edge.
